mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( user_id, comment_content, target_id, target_type, parent_comment_id) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{commentContent}, #{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{parentCommentId} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.user_id AS userId, c.comment_id AS commentId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.comment_content AS commentContent, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.modified_at AS modifiedAt, c.is_deleted AS isDeleted, c.target_id AS targetId, c.target_type AS targetType FROM comments c WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}

SELECT c.user_id AS userId, c.comment_id AS commentId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.comment_content AS commentContent, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.modified_at AS modifiedAt, c.is_deleted AS isDeleted, c.target_id AS targetId, c.target_type AS targetType FROM comments c WHERE c.target_type = #{targetType} AND c.target_id = #{companyPostId} ORDER BY c.parent_comment_id, c.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET comment_content = #{commentContent}, modified_at = now() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
